stories.headline: Indonesia and the EU sign a trade and investment deal
stories.summary: Indonesia and the European Union have signed trade and investment agreements. The agreements will lift 98.5% of tariffs on European Union goods. Negotiations on the deal were concluded in Bali on 23 September 2025.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia to triple the crude oil it stores in Japan
stories.summary: Japan's trade ministry says Saudi Arabia has agreed to triple the volume of crude oil stored in Japan, taking it to 24 million barrels. The oil is held in Japan's joint stockpiling system, which it runs with Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates.

stories.headline: BepiColombo settles into orbit around Mercury
stories.summary: The European Space Agency has announced that the BepiColombo spacecraft inserted itself into orbit around Mercury on 21 November 2026. It is a joint mission with the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency. The stacked spacecraft took eight years to position itself, flying past the Earth, the Moon and Venus on the way.

sources.excerpt: Indonesia and the European Union sign trade and investment agreements that will lift 98.5% of tariffs on EU goods.

Negotiations on the agreement were concluded in Bali on 23 September 2025. On 29 June 2026 the European Commission sent the CEPA and a separate Investment Protection Agreement to the Council of the European Union for signature and conclusion.

The Japanese trade ministry announces that Saudi Arabia agreed to triple the volume of crude oil stored in Japan to 24 million barrels, under Japan's joint stockpiling system with Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, and the United Arab Emirates.
BepiColombo is a joint mission of the European Space Agency (ESA) and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) to the planet Mercury.
MTM was jettisoned on September 3, 2026, and the orbit insertion procedure for the MPO+MMO (Mio) stack was conducted at Mercury on November 21, 2026.

The stacked spacecraft took eight years to position itself to enter Mercury orbit. During this time it used solar electric propulsion and nine gravity assists, flying past the Earth and Moon in April 2020, Venus in 2020 and 2021, and six Mercury flybys between 2021 and 2025.
